repliesWithASeriesWord: A game? Sure, at my pace.
Bye! Off to pounce more things!
Bye. I'll save you a sunny spot.
Gotta go knock something over. Bye!
Ha! Told ya I'm the best!
Hi hi hi! Who are YOU?
Hi hi! Look at all these colors!
Hi! I came out of a present!
I AM the champion, thank you!
I can sniff out the best games.
I move big but I'm in.
I try to be extra colorful.
I'll play. Big paws, gentle taps.
Let's play! I'll be super fast!
My patches say thank you too!
NO WAIT COME BACK— ok bye!
Off on another legendary sniff. Bye!
Oh, hello there. Nice to see you.
Play is exhausting to think about.
See ya! I'll find something new!
Thank you! It's my birthday bow!
That makes my ears go up!
Well, hello. Come sit a while.
You have a good nose too!
You make a big cat happy.
